name: Currency Desk
tagline: Email it amounts and currencies; it replies with conversions and rate trends from central bank data.
description:
Convert an invoice into several currencies, check a past date's rate, or see how a rate moved over a period. It uses reference rates from the European Central Bank and other central banks via the Frankfurter API, and says which date each rate is from.

It connects to api.frankfurter.dev and nowhere else.

capabilities.name: Conversions
capabilities.description: Any amount into several currencies, today or on a past date.

capabilities.name: Trends
capabilities.description: Change, low and high over a period.

capabilities.name: Dated rates
capabilities.description: Every figure says which day's rate it used.
